verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
The more I see, the more I find to love
The more I know, the more I can't withhold my heart
I'm still amazed by who You are

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Somehow it never gets old telling You You're holy
Somehow it never gets old telling You You're lovely
Somehow it never gets old telling You You're worthy

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
For as long as I live
I'll never get tired of giving You praise

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
With every day, another reason why
With evеry breath, another chance to givе my heart
I'm still amazed by who You are

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
How could there be more when
You've already been so good?

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
How could there be more when
You've already been so kind?

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
What else can I say?
I'm still amazed by You
